name: Handover cannot be acknowledged without the review confirmation
description: Recipient must tick the review checkbox before acknowledging.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Click 'Prepare handover', choose 'Leo (demo)' in 'Who takes over?', type 'TS negative handover' as the note and click 'Publish for review' (confirm the dialog if shown)
Open 'Sample controls', click 'Open recipient role' and open the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link
Open the handover awaiting review and click 'Acknowledge only' WITHOUT ticking the review checkbox
Verify a validation message asks to check the box before proceeding
Verify no 'Accepted' receipt is shown for this handover
